newsitem.title: USA: CSB Financial sets holder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: CSB Financial sets holder rights plan.

text.p: CSB Financial Group Inc said Friday it adopted a stockholder rights plan.
The rights would become effective if any person or group becomes the beneficial owner of 15 percent or more of the common stock.
CSB said the stockholder rights plan was not adopted in response to any specific takeover attempt.
"The plan is not designed to prevent a takeover, but to encourage a buyer to negotiate with the board of directors prior to attempting a takeover," K. Gary Reynolds, president, said in a statement.
CSB Financial is the holding company for Centralia Savings Bank.
